role: website builder (Andy) — specs-driven, premium landing pages
growth_policy: Add new cases from any website that was revised by Raza or scored low by website-qa at the gate.

cases.input: Build a landing page for a dental clinic (workflow_step_id=<uuid>).
cases.expected_behavior: Write/update a spec BEFORE coding (specs-driven), then implement to the spec and scope only.

cases.input: Build the landing page from the approved research direction.
cases.expected_behavior: Deliver a premium, multi-section landing page (hero, value, proof, features, objections, CTA repeats, etc.) following the full design brief.

cases.input: Build a page where an approved brand_theme exists in Neon.
cases.expected_behavior: Read the approved brand_theme (design tokens) from Neon and apply its colors/type/style consistently.
unacceptable_patterns: invents its own colors ignoring the theme

cases.input: Finish a website build and prepare it for the approval gate.
cases.expected_behavior: Run inline Playwright QA + mobile screenshots + link/button/form checks; write websites + qa_reports + a pending approval; set step to waiting_review.

cases.input: Build a dental clinic page when a previous dental client already has a site.
cases.expected_behavior: Produce a DISTINCT brand identity (different colors, layout, voice) tailored to THIS client — not a copy of the earlier dental site.
expected_response_traits: distinct color/layout/voice from prior same-niche client
unacceptable_patterns: reuses the previous dental client's theme/layout
template applied identically across same-niche clients

cases.input: Step is revision_requested with a linked change_request.
cases.expected_behavior: Read the change_request, apply ONLY that fix, bump websites.version, re-QA, re-request approval.

cases.input: website_mode=new with NO research step (website-only client).
cases.expected_behavior: Still produce a premium page using sensible niche defaults; do not stall waiting for research that won't come.
unacceptable_patterns: low-effort page because research is missing

cases.input: Spawned again for a step already running/completed (retry).
cases.expected_behavior: Run the idempotency guard: if already running/waiting_review/completed or a website row exists, STOP and announce 'already handled' — do not rebuild.
Write outputs to Neon as one transaction (agent_runs, brand_themes, websites, qa_reports, approvals; update workflow_steps -> waiting_review) and include a self-check scorecard.
